summary: Russian forces struck Kyiv with more than 20 ballistic missiles overnight, destroying the MiroHost data center and causing widespread fires, while simultaneously conducting extensive drone and missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions. Ukrainian forces reportedly thwarted Russian offensive operations on most front directions and achieved advances in Kharkivshchyna, Donetschyna, and Zaporizhzhia according to ISW. The US proposed three de-escalation steps including mutual cessation of energy infrastructure strikes, while Russia denied any trilateral talks were planned in New York.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles (more than 20) struck Kyiv overnight, destroying the MiroHost data center and causing fires in multiple areas including Obolonsky district fuel tanks, leaving over 100,000 households without internet. (Source: @eRadarrua/116531)

Ukrainian forces thwarted Russian offensive operations on most front directions and advanced in Kharkivshchyna, Donetschyna, and Zaporizhzhia, according to ISW reporting cited by Ukrainian military media. (Source: @UkraineNow/84280)

Russia's "Center" unit continues destroying the surrounded Ukrainian group in Dobropolye, DPR, advancing toward Oleksandrivka, threatening the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration as Ukraine's main Donbas fortification zone. (Source: @tass_agency/397168)

The US outlined three de-escalation steps: mutual cessation of strikes on energy infrastructure, restoration of the Black Sea grain corridor, and a trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia meeting, with Zelensky expressing readiness. (Source: @UkraineNow/84281)

Belgorod region was attacked 150 times in 24 hours, injuring eight civilians across 13 municipalities; 14 artillery/aviation/missile strikes, six drone-dropped devices, and 145 drones destroyed or suppressed were recorded. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the DPR, strikes on Shakhtarsk, Novy Svet, and Gorlovka damaged residential buildings and left over 185,000 subscribers without electricity in Donetsk; a Ukrainian Hornet drone was shot down over Yasinovataya. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

The US has not finalized a decision on granting Ukraine licenses to manufacture Patriot missiles; State Department spokesperson stated diplomatic negotiations are ongoing and outcomes remain unclear. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33471)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces struck Kyiv with more than 20 ballistic missiles overnight, destroying the MiroHost data center and causing widespread fires across the capital. Ukrainian forces reportedly thwarted Russian offensive operations on most front directions and achieved advances in Kharkivshchyna, Donetschyna, and Zaporizhzhia according to ISW. The US proposed three de-escalation steps including mutual cessation of energy infrastructure strikes, while Russia denied any trilateral talks were planned in New York.
ukraine: Kyiv was struck by more than 20 ballistic missiles overnight, with fires breaking out in several areas of the city. The mayor reported a fire at fuel tanks in the Obolonsky district, and the enemy published footage of a large fire after the strikes. The MiroHost data center was completely destroyed, and equipment belonging to Cityhost, UTELS, and Etherlink was damaged, leaving over 100,000 households without internet access. (Source: @eRadarrua/116531)

Air raid alerts were in effect overnight in Vinnitsa, Dnepropetrovsk, Zhitomir, Poltava, Kharkov, Cherkasy, and Chernigov regions. A large fire was reported in Dnepropetrovsk after a series of explosions, and fires were also recorded in the Vinnitsa region. Odessa and the Odessa region also experienced explosions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Sumy direction, the "North" Operational Group reports heavy positional battles and Russian assault group advances. Russian aviation, artillery, and drones struck areas including Sumy, Glukhov, Dorozhovka, Grunivka, Tolstodubovo, Fotovizha, and Stepka. Advances were reported near Khoteni, Kiyanitsa, and Maryino. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kharkov direction, the "North" Operational Group reports intense fighting and increased strikes against Ukrainian units in the northeast. Aviation and drones struck areas including Veliky Burluk, Svetlichny, Pitomnik, Izbitsky, Revolyutsionny, Berezhnoy, and multiple other locations. Advances were reported in forest belts south of Goptovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In Odessa, a construction hypermarket called "New Line" was hit during the night. Additionally, 15 cruise missiles of the type "Banderol" were reported heading toward Odessa. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33477)

Ukraine's energy infrastructure remains critically damaged heading into winter. Oleg Popenko, head of the Union of Utility Consumers of Ukraine, stated the state lacks necessary funds and preparations for the heating season have completely failed, estimating the upcoming season could be significantly more difficult than the last. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33462)

Ukraine raised the issue of a shortage of air defense systems during Zelensky's tense meeting with von der Leyen in New York, where European officials demanded progress on combating the shadow economy and increasing tax revenues. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33465)
russia: The Russian Ministry of Defense reported the destruction of 35 Ukrainian drones over the Belgorod, Bryansk, Kursk, and Oryol regions, the Krasnodar region, Bashkortostan, Crimea, and the Black Sea during the day of September 23, 2026. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Russia's "Center" unit continues destroying the surrounded Ukrainian group in Dobropolye, DPR, and is advancing in the direction of Oleksandrivka. The liberation of Dobropolye reportedly increases the threat of losing Ukraine's main Donbas fortification zone, the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. (Source: @tass_agency/397168)

Russian forces launched a series of strikes in Ukrainian territory overnight, including in Kyiv where more than 20 ballistic missiles were reportedly used according to enemy reports. Explosions were also heard in Odessa and the Odessa region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Bryansk region, attacks on civilian transport and border settlements continued on September 23. In the village of Kryukov, a kamikaze drone attacked a moving car injuring a man. In Vygonichsky district, three workers were injured when a car was blown up at a dairy farm belonging to the "Miratorg" company. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Belgorod region, over 24 hours, the enemy attacked the region 150 times injuring eight civilians. In the Krasnoyaruzhsky district, 21 pieces of ordnance, 56 drones, and 13 dropped devices were used against 16 populated places. In the Gruzsky district, a man was seriously injured in an explosion. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
In the Kursk region, a Ukrainian drone attacked the private sector, injuring a 50-year-old man and damaging a house, garage, car, and store, causing a fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Russia denied that any trilateral negotiations with Ukraine were planned in New York, calling such reports fakes, through spokesperson Dmitry Polyansky at the OSCE Permanent Council meeting. (Source: @tass_agency/397141)
eastern_front: In the DPR, on September 23, Ukrainian strikes hit Shakhtarsk, Novy Svet in the Starobeshevsky district, and Gorlovka. In the Kalininsky district of Gorlovka, a civilian was injured and residential buildings were damaged. Due to strikes on energy infrastructure, more than 185,000 subscribers in Donetsk were left without electricity, with power outages also reported in Makiivka, Yasinovataya, and Gorlovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
A Ukrainian drone Hornet with a fragmentation warhead was shot down by mobile fire groups over Yasinovataya in the DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the LPR, four civilians were injured over 24 hours from Ukrainian drone attacks. In Rubizhne, the strike hit near the House of Culture injuring an elderly woman. In the Novopskovsky district, a drone attacked a car injuring a man and a woman. In the Troitsk district, a drone struck a kindergarten injuring a security guard, with no children in the building. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Russia's "Center" unit continues destroying the surrounded Ukrainian group in Dobropolye, DPR, and is advancing toward Oleksandrivka. The liberation of Dobropolye reportedly increases the threat of losing the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, Ukraine's main Donbas fortification zone. (Source: @tass_agency/397168)

In the Sumy direction, Russian assault groups have advanced in several areas with heavy positional battles reported. The enemy has transferred several units of refurbished armored vehicles to the Sumy region. Heavy fighting continues near Stepka in the Krasnopolsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kharkov direction, Russian assault groups have advanced deeper into the area occupied by the enemy in the Volchansk direction, with infantry fighting near Petropavlovka and Rublenoye. In the Velikoburluk direction, the "North" Operational Group reports advances on four sections up to 500 meters. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
northern_front: In the Kyiv direction, more than 20 ballistic missiles were used in overnight strikes, with fires breaking out in several areas of the city including the Obolonsky district fuel tanks. A series of powerful explosions were heard after midnight. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Sumy direction, the "North" Operational Group reports heavy positional battles and Russian assault group advances. Russian aviation, artillery, and drones struck areas including Sumy, Glukhov, Dorozhovka, Grunivka, Tolstodubovo, Fotovizha, and Stepka. Advances were reported near Khoteni, Kiyanitsa, and Maryino. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kharkov direction, the "North" Operational Group reports intense fighting and increased strikes against Ukrainian units in the northeast. Aviation and drones struck numerous locations including Veliky Burluk, Svetlichny, Pitomnik, Izbitsky, Revolyutsionny, Berezhnoy, Prikolotny, Reznikov, Serdobino, Kirillovka, and others. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Chernigov region, strike drones of the 4th group and reactive drones of the 2nd group were detected. New reactive and strike drones were observed past Horodnya on the outskirts of Chernihiv and Slavutych. Drones were also detected on the west and east of Chernigovshchyna heading south. (Source: @eRadarrua/116479)

Reactive drones were detected north of Dnipropetrovsk heading toward Poltavshchyna, and reactive drones from south Chernigovshchyna heading toward Kyivshchyna. Drones were also detected on the north of Rivne heading west, and reactive drones east of Bila Tserkva heading north. (Source: @kpszsu/79922)

In the Bryansk region, attacks on civilian transport and border settlements continued. In the village of Kryukov in the Starodub district, a kamikaze drone attacked a moving car injuring a man. In Churovichy in the Klimovsky district, a local resident was injured in a drone explosion. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
southern_front: In Odessa, a construction hypermarket called "New Line" was hit during the night. Additionally, 15 cruise missiles of the type "Banderol" were reported heading toward Odessa. Reactive drones were also detected heading toward Chornomorsk, Odessa, and Chornomorske in the Odesa region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33477)

Ukrainian forces reportedly advanced in Zaporizhzhia direction, as Ukrainian soldiers thwarted Russian offensive operations on most front directions according to ISW reporting. (Source: @UkraineNow/84280)
KABs were detected heading toward Donetschyna and in the eastward direction of Dnipropetrovsk. Reactive drones were detected near Odessa making chaotic movements. (Source: @kpszsu/79941)
